Specification: This module is a TLC model wrapper for the DijkstraMutex specification rather than a standalone algorithm definition. It declares three model values p1, p2, and p3, defines a constant set containing those values for use as Proc in the model, and maps the model checking configuration to imported top-level operators from the extended module: LSpec as the behavior specification, MutualExclusion as an invariant, and DeadlockFreedom as a temporal property. The file itself contains no state variables, actions, fairness clauses, or proofs; it serves to instantiate and expose model-checking targets for the underlying mutex specification.
